Meghalaya High Court Upholds Bail in Honeymoon Murder Case

The Meghalaya High Court has upheld a lower court's decision to grant bail to Sonam Raghuvanshi, who is accused in a honeymoon murder case. The court noted that preparations for the bail were made without sufficient application of mind. This decision allows the prime accused to be released from jail pending further legal proceedings.
